## Web games: project models
- Web Game code can now use the project's 3D models. Put `/* @ignite-models: MyGame- */` in the game code and every model asset whose name starts with `MyGame-` is packed into the game.
- Load one with `await IgniteModels.load('MyGame-Car')` (the same result as three.js's GLTFLoader). `IgniteModels.names()` lists them.
- When a model has several versions (`MyGame-Car`, `MyGame-Car-v2`, `MyGame-Car-v3`), the highest number is used, so importing a newer copy replaces the old one without changing the code.
- Works in Play mode, web exports, Android builds, and Windows, Steam, Microsoft Store and Xbox builds that use the Web player.
- The Web Game inspector lists the models that will be packed in.
